initialExam.title: LIC HFL 2026 (Housing Finance Limited)
initialExam.description: LIC Housing Finance Limited recruitment for Assistant, Associate, and Assistant Manager positions. LIC HFL is a leading housing finance company in India, a subsidiary of LIC.
initialExam.eligibility: Graduate from a recognized university with 60% marks
initialExam.qualifications: Graduation in any discipline with minimum 60%
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Online Test: 150 questions, 150 marks, 1.5 hours. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Test → Interview → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant, Associate, Assistant Manager in LIC Housing Finance
initialExam.careerGrowth: Assistant → Associate → Assistant Manager → Manager → Senior Manager → Chief Manager → DGM → GM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit lichousing.com 2. Go to Careers 3. Register 4. Fill form 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, PF, Gratuity, Vehicle/Housing Loan benefits

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
